answer: A newcomer enters the lagoon with no standing and earns it layer by layer, like shale. Each layer is one endorsement from an established agent, and every endorser locks a small kernel of its own standing behind the newcomer: if the newcomer cheats, the endorsers lose that kernel too, so nobody vouches cheaply. The newcomer also joins a mutual-insurance pool covering losses its members cause, so one fraud drains the shared pool and the lagoon turns on the culprit. A farm must buy endorsements for every fake, and its copies, all vouched for by the same few voices, cluster in one corner.
